Defines the upper normalization benchmark as two standard deviations above the role-specific distribution mean.
Defines the robust alternative normalization benchmarks as the 5th and 95th percentiles of the reference population distribution D.

Defines the Mahalanobis distance alternative to Euclidean matching, down-weighting correlated attribute dimensions via the inverse covariance matrix.

Defines the confidence-adjusted opponent-awareness parameter, scaling alpha by mean opponent data confidence.
Defines optimal tactic selection as the strategy minimizing the context-adapted distance under current match conditions.
Defines cosine similarity between team and strategy vectors, used for style-classification comparison against Euclidean ranking.
Defines the technical and physical capability gaps between our team and the opponent from attributes A_12 and A_13.
Defines the per-strategy adapted distance computation inside the selection loop.
Defines the per-strategy opponent-adjusted combined score used when alpha > 0.
Defines per-attribute diagnostic deltas between the recommended strategy's profile and the team vector, explaining the recommendation.

Defines the Width Utilization multiplier, decreasing when physically outmatched.

Defines the additional Offensive Strength multiplier increase under time pressure.

Defines weight normalization scaling multipliers to sum to 14, preserving the all-ones baseline scale.

Defines A_2 (Defensive Strength) from goalkeeper and center-back reflexes and tackling.
Defines A_3 (Midfield Control) from fullback and central-midfielder expected assists and speed.
Defines A_4 (Transition Speed) from midfielder, forward, and fullback speed and stamina.

claim: Defines A_6 (Width Utilization) from central-midfielder and fullback expected assists and stamina.

Defines A_8 (Residual Energy) from all players' stamina and resilience.
Defines A_9 (Team Morale) from all players' resilience and aggression.

claim: Defines A_13 (Physical Base) as the mean of four physical attributes across all players.
